profile.headline: Senior front-end developer at Gatling
profile.summary:
I'm a senior frontend developer using Typescript, Angular, React. I used to be a fullstack engineer using Java & Kotlin.

I'm also the CEO of Poule Request where I build SaaS applications and help companies when they need to improve their knowledge on specific topics matching my skillset.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Webpack · Github actions · Redux

positions.title: Chief Executive Officer & Web software engineer
positions.description: I'm helping companies when they need to improve their knowledge on specific topics matching my skillset.

positions.title: Lecturer in Computer Science
positions.description:
Teached the basics of Docker and CI/CD  at the Montpellier Institute of Technology.
Training course of 8 hours with 20 students.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- I participated in the design and development of a newly mobile app meant to extend the user experience of the main product of the company.
Technologies used : Ionic Framework, Angular, Redux, Docker, Gitlab CI, Spring, Quarkus, Web Workers, Firebase Cloud Messaging, BigQuery, push notifications.
I helped improving the existing alerting and monitoring system of the main products of the company by rationalizing the needs of the dev team. Technology used : Grafana.
- I maintained micro services responsible of delivering Lora Messages coming from IoT devices. Technologies used : C#, Kotlin, Docker, Gitlab CI, RabbitMQ.
- I assisted the support team by doing level 1, 2 and 3 support tasks and participating / animating weekly meetings in English with foreign teams across the world.
positions.insights: Skills: Docker · GitLab · Spring Boot · Intégration continue et livraison continue (CI/CD) · Anglais · Angular Material · Angular · Redux · TypeScript · Spring Security · DevOps · Framework Spring · Framework Ionic

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- I joined a team of highly skilled and passionate engineers in charge of developing the main frontend ad SDK of the company in a Real Time Bidding ecosystem.

- I mostly took care of improving the existing GDPR and CCPA privacy features but I also ensured that the analytics would not break due to the changes made by Apple and Google regarding user privacy in their respective browsers.

- Finally, I discovered what "understanding fundamentals web concepts" meant by spending time learning how web browsers implemented a couple of RFCs to work around "edge cases" I encountered.
Technologies used : TypeScript, Webpack, Sumologic, Elastic Search, Docker, Jenkins, AWS, Big Query.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Front end / back end developer using Kotlin, Java, Typescript, GWT.
Also doing some DevOps for the Continuous Integration.

positions.title: Software Developer & support analyst
positions.description:
A one month mission abroad to assist our partner during the deployment phase of the R7 Field Forcasting Tool.

My tasks consisted in helping the local support team and improving our tool/processes while assuring the continuous delivery of expected features.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
Web development using various programming languages, frameworks and CMS :
PHP, SQL, HTML, Less, NodeJS, Wordpress, Joomla.
Also managing the continuous integration cycle (Jenkins, GulpJS).
positions.insights: Skills: Feuilles de style en cascade (CSS) · HTML5 · PHP · WordPress · Joomla!

positions.title: Software Engineer & Scrum master
positions.description: Scrum master and software developer. Mostly doing web development (front and back end) using various tools (NodeJS, MongoDB, Unity3D, C#, ...)

positions.description: Framework design and development around serious games.
